SECONDARY_descriptive_map_DEFECT_r384.STATUS: SUPERSEDED. Pointer added by r384. NO NUMBER IN THIS FILE HAS BEEN CHANGED.
SECONDARY_descriptive_map_DEFECT_r384.defect: The field SECONDARY_descriptive_map ranks channels by abs_diff_over_pooled_sd, whose denominator is the standard deviation of the COMBINED 12 seed means of BOTH arms. The between-arm difference therefore appears in the denominator as well as the numerator, and the statistic saturates at sqrt(132/36) = 1.91485 for any pair of internally tight arms, independently of the size of the difference.
SECONDARY_descriptive_map_DEFECT_r384.evidence: Observed maximum 1.91068 (tib_ant_l_stance), 96% of the algebraic ceiling; 25 of 46 channels above 1.5; vasti_l_swing scored 1.83709 on a between-arm difference of -7.111e-08 with both arms pinned at the model 0.01 activation floor.
SECONDARY_descriptive_map_DEFECT_r384.what_is_wrong: THE SCALE, not the order. At n1 = n2 = 6 the statistic equals u*sqrt(11)/sqrt(10+3u^2) where u = |Cohen d| with the pooled WITHIN-arm sd, which is strictly increasing, so the ranking is unchanged (verified to 1.4e-11 on all 46 channels). What the field cannot support is any reading of its MAGNITUDES as effect sizes.
